verdict.rationale: The Crossplane CLI documents rendering Composition Functions standalone, without a cluster. That lets a platform engineer preview the resources a composition would produce before applying it. Nothing in the evidence shows a plan-style diff against live state that separates creates, updates and destroys. The helm --dry-run item only covers installing Crossplane itself, so it is not credited. missing for 10: diff against current cluster/cloud state, explicit create/update/destroy classification, documented plan-then-apply workflow, independent corroboration.
